scope: M2A additional-extraction ownership overlay; v1 remains immutable historical evidence

rules.new_coordinator_fields: forbidden; additional services are physically owned by the existing parent named in the M2A matrix
rules.parent_injection: a matrix parent is aggregation/injected construction, not an implicit direct include; actual direct includes are only the matrix dependencies array
rules.mutable_owner: one owner per transferred field; no public mutable container/reference
rules.layers: reuse MOD-0.3 v1 deny-unlisted layer model
rules.ports: concrete UI/socket/Kad types only in adapters or ports, never domain-state public headers

approval: M2A-00 contract overlay; any additional module or parent change requires a new reviewed revision
